title: Link for Pre-Bid Meeting against IPC Tender for procurement of 113 Nos. of Impurities at IPC
bodyHtml:
Pre-Bid Meeting against IPC Tender for procurement of 113 Nos. of Impurities at IPC, is schedule to take place via Web Conferencing Facility on Thu, Jan 20, 2022 11:00 AM (IST)

Please join my meeting from your computer, tablet or smartphone.
https://global.gotomeeting.com/join/958662205 (opens in a new tab)

Access Code: 958-662-205

Note:

1. To join meeting via internet browser on computer, click the link provided to download extension and click the downloaded extension to start meeting.
2. To join meeting via smartphone/tablet, download GoToMeeting App from Android Playstore/Apple App Store and click the link provided to start meeting.
3. Ensure uninterrupted Internet connection and good camera with mic to join GoToMeeting from your computer, tablet or smartphone.
4. For any query/assistance to join GoTo Meeting, kindly contact our IT Associate(9718250844 or 8178094289)
